topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: Rain was drumming on the window when the call came. Young fella, college kid, they’re saying he’s been sippin' from someone else's hard work. Plagiarism, they call it. It’s a tough world, gets tougher when you’re steppin' on thin ice and don’t even know it. I’m thinking about this kid, his eyes probably wide, maybe a little scared. Might be he’s just desperate, or maybe he’s been pushed into a corner, felt the walls closing in. I’ve seen how far people will go when they feel the noose tightenin'. I’m gonna take the case, see what’s really goin' down. Maybe I can help him find his way back.
